correctness.rationale: All 2^18 subsets examined; exact graph and induced-degree criterion verified. The 20,652-face augmented complex has a complete 10,321-pair acyclic matching with nine dimension-five and one dimension-six critical cells. Each of 120,240 Hasse covers was checked in a topological ordering. The exact signed 1-by-9 Morse boundary is zero; Hurewicz on the five-skeleton proves the six-cell attaches nullhomotopically. Independently computed augmented F2 ranks corroborate the homology.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical connected cubic distance-regular incidence graph. Its component-size-two higher independence complex is a natural object beyond the ordinary independence stage, and a full mixed-dimensional integral wedge-of-spheres classification answers an exact topology question outside published equidimensional family results. The calculation includes the nontrivial attaching-map step rather than only field-valued Betti numbers.
